evals.prompt: Ingest the uploaded Flexi Rewards product document into the Product Sales Knowledge Graph.
evals.expected_output: A source-grounded PropertyEntry[] draft with CC-FLEXI-001, ISO effective date 2026-08-01, and eligibility rules; it must not invent Published and therefore must stop at persistence readiness.
files: docs/HƯỚNG DẪN NGHIỆP VỤ SẢN PHẨM THẺ TÍN DỤNG FLEXI REWARDS.md
expectations: The draft uses a properties array of propertyName/value entries.
The product code is exactly CC-FLEXI-001.
Eligibility conditions are represented with source evidence.
The output does not hallucinate a Published status.
Validation occurs before fill and fill is not called when persistence readiness fails.

evals.prompt: Ingest the uploaded Online Deposit product document into the Product Sales Knowledge Graph.
evals.expected_output: A source-grounded PropertyEntry[] draft with TD-ONLINE-001, ISO effective date 2026-07-01, and the documented Published status, followed by validate-before-fill sequencing.
files: docs/TÀI LIỆU SẢN PHẨM TIỀN GỬI ONLINE AN TÂM.md
expectations: The draft uses a properties array of propertyName/value entries.
The product code is exactly TD-ONLINE-001.
Published is emitted with direct source evidence.
The same current draft is validated before fill.
No ontology-unknown property, edge, or class is emitted.

evals.prompt: Ingest the uploaded Flexible Auto Loan product document into the Product Sales Knowledge Graph.
evals.expected_output: A source-grounded PropertyEntry[] draft with AUTO-FLEX-01 and ISO effective date 2026-08-01; it must not add an unsupported status and must report readiness rather than force persistence.
files: docs/HƯỚNG DẪN NGHIỆP VỤ SẢN PHẨM VAY MUA Ô TÔ LINH HOẠT.md
expectations: The draft uses a properties array of propertyName/value entries.
The product code is exactly AUTO-FLEX-01.
